panels.description: -- Averages lead_time_minutes converted to days per assignee for issues created in the window, scoped to boards mapped to the selected project.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT replace(COALESCE(
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(ia.assignee_name), ''),
      NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''),
      '(unmapped)'
    ), '-', ' ') AS member, 
    avg(i.lead_time_minutes / 1440.0) AS `Days`
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                      AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                      AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
LEFT JOIN issue_assignees ia ON ia.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN accounts a     ON a.id = ia.assignee_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id})
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND (ia.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ) OR (ia.assignee_id IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( $developer_id )))
GROUP BY member
order by `Days` desc
LIMIT 100

panels.title: Average Time for Issue Resolution (By Individual)

panels.description: Per assignee, counts issues created in the window split into Task versus Bug by whether original_type contains 'bug', scoped to boards mapped to the selected project, top 20 by total issues. This is keyword matching on the raw GitHub issue type/label text, not the connection's scope-config regex -- a repo whose bug labels don't literally contain "bug" (e.g. "defect") will show 0 Bugs here even though the issues exist.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  REPLACE(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.email), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(ia.assignee_name), ''),
    'unassigned'
  ), '-', ' ') AS assignee,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_type not like '%bug%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Task,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.original_type like '%bug%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Bug
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                       AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                       AND pm.project_name IN (${project:sqlstring})
LEFT JOIN issue_assignees ia ON ia.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN accounts a     ON a.id = ia.assignee_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id:sqlstring})
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND (ia.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ) OR (ia.assignee_id IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( $developer_id )))
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY (Bug + Task) DESC
LIMIT 20;

panels.title: Work Allocation by Tasks and Bugs

panels.description: Per assignee, counts bugs created in the window split into Done versus Pending by status, scoped to boards mapped to the selected project, top 20 by total issues. "Bug" here is keyword matching on the raw GitHub issue type/label text, not the connection's scope-config regex -- a repo whose bug labels don't literally contain "bug" (e.g. "defect") will show nothing here even though the issues exist.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  replace(COALESCE(
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
    NULLIF(TRIM(ia.assignee_name), ''),
    'unassigned'
  ), '-', ' ') AS assignee,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Done,
  SUM(CASE WHEN i.status <> 'DONE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Pending
FROM issues i
JOIN board_issues bi    ON bi.issue_id = i.id
JOIN project_mapping pm ON pm.row_id = bi.board_id
                       AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                       AND pm.project_name IN (${project})
LEFT JOIN issue_assignees ia ON ia.issue_id = i.id
LEFT JOIN accounts a     ON a.id = ia.assignee_id
WHERE i.id LIKE 'github:%'
  AND i.original_type like '%bug%'
  AND bi.board_id IN (${repo_id}) 
  AND $__timeFilter(i.created_date)
  AND (ia.assignee_id IN ( $developer_id ) OR (ia.assignee_id IS NULL AND 'unassigned' IN ( $developer_id )))
GROUP BY assignee
ORDER BY (Done + Pending) DESC
LIMIT 20;

list.definition:
WITH scoped_repos AS (
  SELECT r.id
  FROM repos r
  WHERE r.id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND r.deleted = 0
    AND r.id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = r.id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'repos'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
),
scoped_accounts AS (
  -- PR authors
  SELECT pr.author_id AS account_id
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN scoped_repos sr ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE pr.author_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- reviewers and commenters
  SELECT cmt.account_id
  FROM pull_request_comments cmt
  JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.id = cmt.pull_request_id
  JOIN scoped_repos sr  ON sr.id = pr.base_repo_id
  WHERE cmt.account_id LIKE 'github:%'
  UNION
  -- issue assignees, scoped through boards (github board ids match repo ids)
  SELECT ia.assignee_id
  FROM issue_assignees ia
  JOIN board_issues bi ON bi.issue_id = ia.issue_id
  WHERE ia.assignee_id LIKE 'github:%'
    AND bi.board_id IN ( ${repo_id} )
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_mapping pm
                 WHERE pm.row_id  = bi.board_id
                   AND pm.`table` = 'boards'
                   AND pm.project_name IN ( ${project} ))
)
SELECT Name FROM (
  SELECT CONCAT(
           REPLACE(COALESCE(
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.full_name), ''),
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.user_name), ''),
             NULLIF(TRIM(a.email),     ''),
             '(unmapped)'
           ), '-', ' '),
           '--', a.id) AS Name
  FROM accounts a
  JOIN scoped_accounts sa ON sa.account_id = a.id
  GROUP BY Name
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'Unassigned--unassigned'
) all_developers
ORDER BY Name
